derived_hs_private_credit_share_of_ledge.label: Private-credit share of the hyperscaler/neocloud deal ledger
derived_hs_private_credit_share_of_ledge.population: 66 signed or closed rows of the hyperscaler/neocloud deal ledger (frontend/data/ledgers/deals.json), $539.23bn total; announcements, contract rows, backstops, rating actions and commentary excluded. Known gap: 15 signed-financing-shaped sub-transactions worth $58.1bn are recorded inside other rows' "terms" as "|| ALSO" blocks (each with its own date, entity and URL) and are not separately summed into this total or its numerators. Numerator: rows tagged structure "private credit facility" (10 rows, $32.69bn) — the ledger's own tag for a facility priced and syndicated as private credit (CoreWeave's DDTLs, Crusoe/Brookfield, the APLD/Macquarie tranches); a syndicated bank loan stays "bank loan" even where press says it will be sold on to private-credit funds.
derived_hs_private_credit_share_of_ledge.formula: sum(private credit facility rows, USD) ÷ sum(every signed or closed row, USD); decision 12.17's with-Beignet point adds the press-sourced Beignet Investor LLC SPV bond to BOTH the numerator and the denominator (Beignet is a status:"commentary" row, excluded from the plain ledger total), so it stays a share of a stated, consistent population rather than a numerator-only addition to the plain-ledger share. Decision 12.17 makes this with-Beignet point the headline; the plain point is stated second.

points.c: including the Beignet SPV bond (caveat: double-counts the Hyperion JV/SPV row's ~$27bn)
points.caveat: Beignet Investor LLC's $27.3bn notes finance the same Hyperion JV the ledger's Meta/Blue Owl JV/SPV row already counts once; this point adds Beignet to both the numerator and the denominator per decision 12.17 and is not additive with the JV/SPV total.

derived_hs_jv_spv_lease_backed_share.label: JV/SPV and lease-backed share of the hyperscaler/neocloud deal ledger
derived_hs_jv_spv_lease_backed_share.population: 66 signed or closed rows of the hyperscaler/neocloud deal ledger (frontend/data/ledgers/deals.json), $539.23bn total; announcements, contract rows, backstops, rating actions and commentary excluded. Known gap: 15 signed-financing-shaped sub-transactions worth $58.1bn are recorded inside other rows' "terms" as "|| ALSO" blocks (each with its own date, entity and URL) and are not separately summed into this total or its numerators. Numerator: project notes backed by a hyperscaler lease or a Google backstop (10 rows, $19.52bn) — APLD's ComputeCo issuers, Cipher's Compute/Black Pearl issuers, TeraWulf's WULF Compute and Flash Compute, Hut 8 DC, Switch and Aligned Data Centers; a general JV/SPV-structure row that is not one of these named project notes (Hyperion, the Crusoe/Blue Owl venture) is not counted here. Known gap (one instance of the wider gap this key's own denominator already discloses above): Cipher's $810m Stingray Compute LLC note is folded into another row's terms as an "ALSO" sub-transaction and is not separately summed here either, and its entity name is not one of this numerator's named markers even if it were promoted to a row.
derived_hs_jv_spv_lease_backed_share.formula: sum(the named lease-backed project-note rows, USD) ÷ sum(every signed or closed row, USD)

derived_hs_private_credit_facility_month.label: Private-credit facility financing, by month
derived_hs_private_credit_facility_month.population: Private credit facility rows of the hyperscaler/neocloud deal ledger, signed or closed, grouped by the row's own date; not cumulative, and not the same figure as chart H12's running total by structure.
derived_hs_private_credit_facility_month.formula: sum(private credit facility rows dated in the month, USD)
